description: I am a Robotics Engineer and Writer from Cluj with a background in Web Design, Web Development and AI. Intrus' goal is to create a visual narrative, simple yet dynamic, that tells the story of the expanding frontier of humanity, of its roots and its mission to dive into the unknown looking for answers.
summary:
Long before the first rocket left the ground, someone looked up and wondered. notForgotten begins there, at the dawn of human curiosity, and follows that restless question all the way into the dark between the stars.

Made for teenagers, but open to anyone who ever stared at the night sky, it tells the stories of the machines we sent out to answer it. Spin each spacecraft in a living 3D view and listen: rovers crawling across red dust, copters lifting into thin air, landers touching down in silence, satellites keeping watch from orbit. Every one carries its own story.

Then step into the chair at mission control. Voyager 1, billions of miles from home, is failing. Probe its memory, move the code blocks, and bring it back. You won’t just read about discovery. You’ll feel what it is to be the scientist who makes it happen.

Some things deserve to be notForgotten.
details:
Built with VSCode, HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, running on nothing more than our own laptops and our own minds, hosted on Github Pages. AI helped us along the way, completing code and generating video, but every idea, every story, and every mission is ours.

Intended Impact

We want to bring back the feeling of looking up and wondering. Many teenagers grow up surrounded by screens but rarely feel awe, so NotForgotten turns the history of space exploration into something they can touch, spin, and step inside. By putting them in the seat of mission control, we hope they discover that science isn’t distant or reserved for geniuses. It’s a puzzle they can solve, a mission they can save.

If even one player closes the game and goes outside to look at the stars, we’ve done what we set out to do.
